label: Town of Calais
header:
# Town of Calais municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 5; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Calais Selectboard members: William Davis; Jordan Keyes (Chair); Barbara Mcandrew [directory casing]; Christy Mihaly; and Jamie Moorby (Vice Chair).
Town of Calais official ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026: Jordan Keyes was the candidate for the three-year Selectboard term and William Davis for the two-year term; both were elected.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Teegan Dykeman-Brown as Town Clerk of Calais.
Town of Calais official ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026: Teegan Dykeman-Brown was the candidate for Town Clerk, three-year term ending March 2029; she was elected.

Town of Calais charter, Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 108C (2017, No. M-11): section 3 provides that the Selectboard shall annually appoint a Town Treasurer, who is also collector of current taxes.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Kari Bradley as Treasurer of Calais.

Town of Calais charter, Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 108C (2017, No. M-11): section 4 provides that the Selectboard shall annually appoint a Town Auditor, and shall contract a certified public accountant audit at least every three years.

Town of Calais official website: the Selectboard's appointed auditor is the New England Municipal Resource Center, an accounting firm, not an individual; a firm cannot hold a person record, so the post is recorded with no membership.
Town of Calais, approved minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 5, 2024: Gus Seelig was elected Moderator for the ensuing year.
Town of Calais official website: the town's 2026 Certificate of Votes records Gus Seelig re-elected Moderator at the Annual Town Meeting of March 3, 2026.
Town of Calais official website: the 2025 Town Report's town officers table lists three listers: Wilson Hughes, John McCullough, and Toby Talbot.
Town of Calais official ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026: Toby Talbot was the candidate for Lister, three-year term ending March 2029; he was elected.
Town of Calais, Warning for the Annual Meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed): Article 3 elects a Trustee of Public Funds for a three-year term expiring 2029.

Town of Calais official website: the 2025 Town Report lists three Trustees of Public Funds: Rodney A. Buck, Scott G. Grzankowski, and Steve Killoran; the town's 2026 Certificate of Votes records Buck (as 'Rod Buck') re-elected.
Town of Calais, Warning for the Annual Meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed): Article 3 elects a Cemetery Commissioner for a five-year term expiring 2031.
Town of Calais official website: the 2025 Town Report lists five Cemetery Commissioners: Michael Fullerton, Juanita Nunn, Laura Dailey, Shari Fitch, and Sage Kennedy; Dailey was re-elected in 2026.

Town of Calais, Selectboard meeting minutes, May 18, 2026: the Selectboard's annual appointments list includes 'Sandra Ferver: Delinquent Tax Collector.' The office is filled separately from the treasurer (17 V.S.A. section 2651d); Ferver, the town's former elected treasurer, is recorded as the appointed holder.
Town of Calais official website: the 2025 Town Report's town officers roster prints the Constable office as VACANT. Structure only: the seat stands vacant and no holder is recorded.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Calais justices of the peace: Janet Ancel, W. Scott Bassage, Charlotte Hanna Bassage, Kristina Bielenberg, Barbara Butler, Dillon Burns, and Michael Loignon.

jp_election.name: Town of Calais Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Calais justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
